title: Protection Charm With Traditional Korean Patchwork
description: These classes center on the theme, "The Art of Being With...," and are related to the exhibit at Minneapolis Central Library. Together, they explore the idea that giving and receiving care and love brings meaning to our lives. Thoughtfulness is essential in finding purpose; without it, everyday moments can feel less significant. Rather than focusing on technical skills, each class highlights the meaningful act of creating objects that reflect care. Participants will work with ceramic painting and traditional textile elements to practice thoughtfulness and express care for themselves and others. No previous experience is needed; all skill levels are welcome. In session one of the two-part series, participants will paint and work with textiles. In session two, textile work will be incorporated and ceramic pieces will be painted and assembled into the finished object. Materials provided. Register for both sessions. This program is funded with money from Minnesota’s Arts and Cultural Heritage Fund. September 12 : Painting on ceramic pollack + sewing Jogakbo. Cultural significance: In a custom called Bugeo Aekmaegi, dried pollack uses its wide-open eyes and mouth to watch for evil spirits and swallow misfortune. This is paired with Jogakbo (patchwork), the traditional Korean art of "wrapping luck" and fortune. September 26 : Painting on ceramic old coin + sewing Jogakbo. Cultural significance: These represent Byeoljeon, rare commemorative coins gifted by mothers to marrying daughters on decorative key pendants to wish for marital harmony and prosperity. This is paired with Jogakbo patchwork to wrap and hold that family fortune together. View The Art of Being With: Light, Shadow, Wind and Body exhibit – on display August 8-September 27 in Cargill Gallery on the second floor of Minneapolis Central Library.

metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Sewing Nature Pillowcases
description: Meet at the Jacob V. Brower Visitor Center. Interested in learning how to sew? Come and learn the basics of sewing here at Itasca State Park! Sew a nature-themed pillowcase to take on your camping adventures! Pillowcase fabric will feature plants and animals found in Itasca! All experience levels are welcome! Supplies, materials, and sewing machines will be provided (feel free to bring your own sewing machine). Suitable for ages 10 and over.  Space is limited. Email to register at Anna.Fairbanks@state.mn.us. Email by 8 a.m. on Saturday, September 19 to register.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

description: Grab a Scavenger Hunt Form at the Park Office to start your adventure!
address: Mille Lacs Kathio State Park, MN

title: Who- Cooks- For -You? Owl Pellet Dissection (all ages)
description: What does an owl make for lunch? Come find out firsthand by dissecting owl pellets and find out how they are such amazing nighttime hunters. Meet in the visitor center.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Dragonfly Friends- Nature Table
description: Dragonflies love to munch on mosquitoes and flies that bother us during our hikes. What makes them great hunters? Learn about their bodies while making your very own dragonfly friend that will protect you on your next hike. Drop by the naturalist table at the visitor center.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Birding Basics
description: Ever want to try out birding? Come to the Visitor Center where we will go over techniques, tips, and technologies that can be used for birders of all ages and abilities!  This program is for new birders and will have a short presentation followed by an excursion outside to bird!
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: SPECIAL EVENT: Archaeology Day
description: Come enjoy a day full of demonstrations, displays and activities that highlight the archaeology and rich cultural heritage of the Mille Lacs area.   Co-sponsored by MNDNR, MAS, and SCSU. The event will take place in the park�s picnic area, located in front of the Interpretive/Visitor Center and near the swimming hole. The building is closed due to construction. All activities will take place outdoors. Rain or inclement weather will cancel the event.
address: Mille Lacs Kathio State Park, MN
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Brilliant Bears
description: Bears are amazing creatures that live closer than most would think!  Visit this nature table to take a sneak peek into their amazing world near the Stillwater trail head of the Brown's Creek State Trail
address: Brown's Creek State Trail Stillwater, MN
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Where the Waters Meet
description: For thousands of years people have followed the rivers to where the park is located today. During this trail walk, visit the sites where the past and present meet and gain a better understanding of why this area is so significant.  No registration required. Meet at the Thomas C. Savage Visitor Center (two miles from park entrance. Plan for an additional 10 minute drive through the park). This walk will be just under a mile on flat, paved and gravel trails.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Minnesota Mussels
description: What do Monkeyfaces, Heelsplitters, and Pocketbooks have in common? They are just a few species of mussels that call Minnesota's waters home! Mussels play an important role in the health of our state's freshwater ecology, but most species are threatened or endangered. Stop by just outside the visitor center any time between 1:00-2:00PM to learn more about these freshwater friends.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Brilliant Beavers: Investigation Station
description: A beaver's unique adaptations help them change the landscape in surprising ways. Drop by to discover how they do their work and where you can find evidence of them at the park. Find this ongoing station outside the park's visitor center. Most participants spend about ten minutes. Canceled in the event of rain.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Animal Tracks
description: Many animals live in the park, but we might not always know they are there. Use your investigative skills to examine some of the clues they leave behind to let us know who they are. Meet at the picnic shelter. This program is free to attend, but a vehicle permit is required for all motor vehicles entering the park. It is $7 for a day or $35 for a 12-month permit. Permits can be purchased online or at the park office.
address: Nerstrand Big Woods State Park, MN
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Fall Color Hike
description: Reds, oranges, and yellows transform the Big Woods into a landscape full of beauty in the fall.  Join our naturalist for a hike exploring this season of change. Hike covers roughly a mile and includes steps, a portion of boardwalk and hilly terrain. Sturdy shoes are recommended. Front and backpack carriers are encouraged for younger children as the trail is not stroller friendly. Meet at the picnic shelter. This program is free to attend, but a vehicle permit is required for all motor vehicles entering the park. It is $7 for a day or $35 for a 12-month permit. Permits can be purchased online o
address: Nerstrand Big Woods State Park, MN
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Celebrate The Salmon Run
description: Celebrate the Pink Salmon spawning run up the Gooseberry River! This unique salmon run happens in the fall when non-native Pacific Pink Salmon migrate from Lake Superior up the Gooseberry River to the Lower Falls pool, where they spawn and die. Talk to naturalists about this phenomenon and make a fish print while supplies last. The exact dates of the salmon run are unknown, but this is the predicted time based on past migrations.   Find the salmon run and naturalists below Lower Falls. Park for free at the wayside rest and walk .2 miles to Lower Falls.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Fall Color Extravaganza
description: Every year the changing colors of the forest herald the approach of autumn.  Did you know that many of the colors we see in leaves are caused by chemicals present in the leaf all year round?  Why do we see different colors at different times of the year?  How do we see color at all?  Drop by to explore these and other fall color questions and try your hand at some fall nature art! Drop in at the Lake Clayton Picnic Shelter
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Fall Leaf Color Walk
description: Bring your young ones to Lake Bemidji State Park to experience the colorful season of fall! As we go on a leisurely walk, we will learn why leaves change color and explore how many colors we can find in the forest. Meet by the Playground. We will be walking along the paved Rocky Point Trail up to the overlook and back, which is about 1 mile.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Fall Colors Serenity Stroll
description: Meet at the West Picnic Area by the Rocky Point Trail trailhead.  Indulge your senses and rejuvenate your spirit surrounded by nature's rainbow of fall colors. Immerse yourself in tranquility as you embark on a guided journey designed to promote relaxation, mindfulness and well-being to celebrate the beginning of fall. We will be walking on the Rocky Point Trail up to the overlook of Lake Bemidji and back. This trail is paved and is a one-mile loop. Wear comfortable shoes. Meet in the west picnic area by the Rocky Point Trail trailhead. Look for the blue "program today" flag.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: Measure the Potholes with a Naturalist
description: What lives inside a glacial pothole? How do you measure how deep one is? Is each one the same? Join the park naturalist to try simple experiments and measurements to discover these answers and more on a short 1/4-mile walk. This is a great guided walk for ages 5 and up, with chances for making guesses and hands-on activities. Meet outside the park's visitor center. This program takes place entirely outdoors and will be canceled or postponed in the event of lightning or thunder.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)

title: The Great Beak Match-up: Investigation Station
description: Big, small, long, or short, a bird's beak is a tool that helps it survive. So many different styles exist in nature. Drop-by with the park naturalist to discover a few of them in this hands-on matching activity with replica bird beaks. Most participants spend about ten minutes at this ongoing activity station. Find this station along the flat sidewalk outside the visitor center. Canceled in the event of rain.
metro_area: Minnesota Statewide (Twin Cities metro + Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud, Mankato, Moorhead, Brainerd, Bemidji, Winona, Alexandria)
